name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux from PyPI through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc32): reading a table now returns its rows. The same missing piece that broke the Excel import in rc31 was also emptying every table READ on those older-style screens - one screen reported no rows where it has 406. That is what the tools use to check a row exists before changing it, and to confirm a change afterwards, so until now they could do neither. Nothing was ever reported as saved when it had not been; the checking simply could not reach anything. Also: asking to import into a table that has no import button now tells you which tables on that screen do have one. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
